# RevealUI

> Build your business on software you can run yourself. Five primitives: People, Content, Offers, Payments, and Agents. Open source (MIT) plus Fair Source (FSL-1.1-MIT) Pro packages. Self-hostable. Your deployment uses accounts and infrastructure you control; paid runtime features use license validation and third-party integrations have their own dependencies.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://docs.revealui.com): Architecture, primitives, deployment, agent integration
- [What works today](https://docs.revealui.com/WHAT_WORKS_TODAY): Honest pre-launch status: what is tested, what is stub, what is not yet wired
- [Architecture](https://docs.revealui.com/ARCHITECTURE): Five primitives, apps, packages, deploy topology

## Getting started

Live public paths only:

- `npx create-revealui@latest`
- GitHub templates (Use this template): [starter](https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui-template-starter), [basic-blog](https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui-template-basic-blog), [portfolio](https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui-template-portfolio), [e-commerce](https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui-template-e-commerce)
- Apify [governed-agent-run](https://apify.com/revealuistudio/governed-agent-run): pay-per-event. Receipt verification is $0.00001, not free
- [Quick start](https://docs.revealui.com/QUICK_START): local stack walkthrough
- [Local-first](https://docs.revealui.com/LOCAL_FIRST): Run the stack on your machine

- [Templates](https://revealui.com/templates): Supported starting points and their setup requirements.

## Source code

- [GitHub](https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui): Public monorepo. OSS packages under MIT; Pro packages (`@revealui/ai`, `@revealui/engines`, `@revealui/harnesses`, `@revealui/mcp`, `@revealui/services`) under FSL-1.1-MIT (source-visible; MIT conversion follows published change-date terms).
- [Fair Source explainer](https://docs.revealui.com/fair-source): What FSL-1.1-MIT means in practice
- [Claims ledger](https://revealui.com/claims): Covered marketing statements and cited evidence; automated checks do not establish every claim’s truth

## The thesis

RevealUI is the self-hosted runtime where your business and the AI agents that run it live under one roof. Configure supported agent tools, permissions, and a supported local or hosted model provider. Agents and integrations require the appropriate license and setup.

Supported actions can leave signed records when audit signing is configured. Pro adds downloadable roots and inclusion proofs; a record does not establish that the business outcome was correct.

Five primitives make up the runtime: People, Content, Offers, Payments, Agents.

- [Read the full thesis](https://revealuistudio.com/blog/ui-of-the-future): "The UI of the Future Has Yet to Reveal Itself"
- [Forward-deployed handoff](https://revealuistudio.com/blog/open-runtime-for-fde-work): "The open runtime for forward-deployed agent work"

## Status (honest, pre-launch)

- Zero paying customers. Used in production by the team that maintains it.
- Stripe live mode is on for product billing; no paid customer base yet.
- Inference is selected from configuration. Set the provider explicitly; local runners require suitable hardware and hosted providers incur their own usage costs.
- NeonDB is the primary database. Supabase is not an internal datastore.
- Professional services and fixed-bid delivery: [revealuistudio.com](https://revealuistudio.com)
